scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('assets/vendor/bootstrap', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css', 'assets/vendor/bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js', 'assets/vendor/bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js'); console.log('✅ Bootstrap vendor assets synchronized to assets/vendor/');"
